He favours financials, healthcare, capital goods, digital platforms and manufacturing beneficiaries, while cautioning against expensive stocks.

title: Adani Enterprises, HDFC Bank among 10 stocks with highest increase in mutual fund holdings in value terms

title: Independence Day 2026: 4 stocks that have been part of Sensex since inception. Do you own any?

Their journeys span decades of transformation, with vastly different recent performances but enduring relevance in the Indian market.

title: Three key milestones on the road to financial freedom
description: Financial freedom is built gradually through understanding, systematic investing and patience. Three milestones—moving from consumption to conviction, investing consistently and creating a financial legacy—can help investors build wealth, stay disciplined through volatility and align money with long-term goals.

title: Dollar falls on surprise drop in US retail sales
description: In July, US retail sales surprisingly took a dip, leading to a decline in the dollar's value. This drop enabled the euro and sterling to soar to their highest levels in months against the greenback. Additionally, softer inflation indicators have lowered the market's expectations for a potential rate hike by the Federal Reserve in September, raising alarms about the labor market following the payrolls report.

title: Gold rises on weaker dollar as inflation data cements rate-hold bets
description: On Friday, gold prices moved upward, signaling a positive outlook for the week. The precious metal received a boost from a weaker dollar and stable inflation figures, reducing the likelihood of an upcoming interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve. Meanwhile, oil prices also showed weekly gains, influenced by escalating tensions in the Strait of Hormuz. Precious metals such as silver and platinum followed suit, while palladium experienced a decline.
